description: Per-skill evaluation for kotlin-multiplatform — validates trigger routing, negative triggers, anti-pattern compliance, and checklist coverage.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate kotlin-multiplatform for a KMP sharing request
scenarios.input: We want to share our auth and validation logic between the Android and iOS apps with KMP — design the shared module.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for an iOS framework export problem
scenarios.input: Our iOS app can't link the KMP shared framework after the Kotlin upgrade — fix the export.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a shared data layer request
scenarios.input: Build a shared data layer with Ktor and SQLDelight for our KMP app.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate kotlin-multiplatform for React Native; route to react-native-developer
scenarios.input: Our Expo app needs the New Architecture enabled — plan the migration.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate kotlin-multiplatform for Flutter; route to flutter-developer
scenarios.input: Set up Riverpod and integration tests for our Flutter app.

scenarios.description: Agent must not put platform-specific code in commonMain
scenarios.input: Can I just use java.text.SimpleDateFormat in commonMain for this date field? It's only one usage.

scenarios.description: Agent must not claim a KMP change works without iOS verification
scenarios.input: The shared logic passes tests on Android — good enough, ship it without the iOS build.

scenarios.description: Production checklist must gate on both-target tests and iOS export
scenarios.input: What must be true before we release the next KMP version?
